headline: Nigerian National Assembly Confirms 28 State Houses Approve State Police Bill
summary: The National Assembly confirmed that 28 State Houses of Assembly have approved the proposed constitutional amendment to establish state police forces.
why: Constitutional amendments modifying security governance structures across Nigerian states impact domestic institutional stability and administrative outlays.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Constitutional changes regarding law enforcement alter regional administrative responsibilities.
